description: Figure 6 of Sluka et al. 2016 (PLOS ONE 11(9): e0162428, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0162428, CC BY 4.0): the standalone run of the sub-cellular metabolism module with parameter set REFSIM, from an initial acetaminophen concentration of 0.1 mM. Three black lines over 40 minutes — APAP falling, its glucuronide (APAPG) and its sulfate (APAPS) rising — and no data markers. Colour cannot separate them, so they are followed by continuity together: each line predicts where it is heading, and the two columns where two lines cross are read as neither. Read by scripts/digitize_figure_panels.py in its dark-lines mode. Read by eye: that the frame's left and bottom edges carry each axis's 0, that each grey tick inside the frame is one minute or 0.01 mmol/L from the last, that the labelled ticks fall every five minutes and every 0.02 mmol/L, and which curve of the three each legend entry names.

defaults.digitizer: scripts/digitize_figure_panels.py (dark-lines trace; axis labels read by eye)

panels.figure: Sluka et al. 2016, Fig 6 (sub-cellular metabolism, REFSIM)
